independentVerifier.independentMethod: Enumerate original simple stem-plus-cycle walks with minimum distance removed; match full walks to fixed plan, then check whether any original admissible assignment can reach minimum. Never use the new capacity inequality to determine expected feasibility.
arithmeticReview: An accepted simple outward walk plus its physical reverse stem contains fewer than 2*N edge additions; nonnegative prefix totals are bounded by accepted maximum distance and road budget.

Separate full-distance and road-distance IEEE accumulation error is bounded conservatively by 2*N*EPS*(Dmax+Rmax). The implementation rounds a larger 8*N envelope upward, also covering rounded quotient error.
The threshold deduction covers rounding of minimumDistance*(1-roadFraction). Safe-integer/finite guards disable the optional bound when its integer envelope cannot be represented safely.
Fixed stem costs count actual reverse edge distances. A connector stem with a nonconnector inverse disables the fixed-trail bound because its variable return can add trail distance.
The bound applies only to a COMPLETE fixed-trail plan, never a growing trail prefix. It does not justify altering road ranking or returning a longer connection to satisfy minimum mileage.
independentVerifier.limits: Bounded tiny-graph correctness evidence; does not establish large-frontier memory safety or real-data composition performance.
